paras.en: A parallel port is a parallel communication physical interface. It is also known as a printer port. Parallel ports can transmit multiple bits over several wires at a time. These ports have 25 pins in which 8 pins transmit one byte of information and the others are used for transmitting control signals. Parallel ports are named as LPT1, LPT2 and LPT3. In today’s modern computers parallel ports have been replaced with USB ports.
